source.symbol: Windows application versus sandbox-only link libraries
source.validation: Exact public Git source at the fixed comparison revision. Claims are static observations. No runtime, build, lint or live accessibility validation ran.

text:
if CONFIG["OS_ARCH"] == "WINNT":
    RCINCLUDE = "splash.rc"
    DEFINES["MOZ_THUNDERBIRD"] = True

    OS_LIBS += [
        "advapi32",
        "shell32",
        "ntdll",
    ]

    # Don't build thunderbird.exe with CETCOMPAT, because we need to be able to
    # only enable it for processes that are not using JIT in xul.dll.
    LINK_FLAGS["CETCOMPAT"] = []

if CONFIG["OS_ARCH"] == "Darwin":
    OS_LIBS += [
        "-framework CoreFoundation",
    ]

if CONFIG["MOZ_SANDBOX"] and CONFIG["OS_ARCH"] == "WINNT":
    # For sandbox includes and the include dependencies those have
    LOCAL_INCLUDES += [
        "/security/sandbox/chromium",
        "/security/sandbox/chromium-shim",
    ]

    USE_LIBS += [
        "sandbox_s",
    ]

    OS_LIBS += [
        "shlwapi",
        "user32",
        "version",
        "winmm",
    ]

    DELAYLOAD_DLLS += [
        "winmm.dll",
        "user32.dll",
    ]
